AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R19-03

CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 13a) All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda. An applicant or interested citizen who wishes to appeal any Planning Commission decision (Item #13a) may file an appeal with the City Clerk's office within 15 days after the date of the Planning Commission's decision.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
(Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.)
1.
Draft City Council Action Minutes
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
December 11, 2018; Special Meeting
b.
December 11, 2018; Regular Meeting
c.
December 17, 2018; Special Meeting
Minutes
2.
Demands of January 9, 2019
Recommendation: Approve payment of Motions #1 and #2.
a.
Motion #1 – Payroll Warrant of December 28, 2018
b.
Motion #2 – Warrant Register of January 9, 2019
Demands
3.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept the gifts as presented.
Staff Report
4.
Special Event Application for Palos Verdes High School's Annual "Remember the Tritons Walk" Scheduled for Saturday, February 22, 2019 from 12:30 P.M. to 4:00 P.M. and to Post Banners Promoting the Event
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Special Event Application allowing Palos Verdes High School's annual "Remember the Tritons Walk" to take place in Palos Verdes Estates on February 22, 2019, and allow the posting of banners promoting the event.
Staff Report
5.
Approval and Transfer of Projected Property Taxes Collected Through Measure E into the General Fund and to Receive and File the Annual Special Tax Accountability Report for Fiscal Year Ending June 30, 2018
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council “transfer in” the projected property taxes collected through Measure E of $2,006,909.10 into the City’s General Fund for Palos Verdes Estates Police Department expenditures and receive and file the Annual Special Tax Accountability Report for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2018.
Staff Report
6.
Receive and File a Letter to the California Public Utilities Commission Regarding Investor Owned Utilities Wildfire Mitigation Plans
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file a letter sent to the California Public Utilities Commission regarding investor owned utilities wildfire mitigation plans in acknowledgement of its approval.
Staff Report
7.
Granting of Easement and Right-of-Way to Southern California Edison for Installation of Electric Distribution Facilities in City Parklands Located Behind 3411 La Selva Place
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council grant SCE a 6-foot and 10-foot wide easement and right-of-way for installation of electrical distribution facilities as outlined in the attached Grant of Easement documents.
Staff Report
8.
Resolution R19-01; Denying the Appeal and Affirming the Planning Commission Approval of NC-1626-18; Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a Remodel and Addition to an Existing Single-Family Residence Located at 1509 Espinosa Circle
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R19-01; denying the appeal and affirming Planning Commission approval of NC-1626-18; Neighborhood Compatibility for a remodel and addition to an existing single-family residence located at 1509 Espinosa Circle, with modifications.
Staff Report
9.
Cancellation of Agreement with Los Angeles County Department of Agricultural Commissioner/Weights and Measures for Weed Abatement Services and Adoption of Resolution R19-02: a Resolution of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates, California, Partially Delegating the Power to Conduct Weed Abatement to the Consolidated Fire Protection District of Los Angeles County
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council cancel the agreement with Los Angeles County Department of Agricultural Commissioner/Weights and Measures for weed abatement services and adopt Resolution R19-02 delegating the power to conduct weed abatement to the Consolidated Fire Protection District of Los Angeles County.
Staff Report
10.
Approval of Amendment No. 2 to the Professional Services Agreement between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and Michael Baker International for Interim Planning Services
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve Amendment No. 2 to the Professional Services Agreement with Michael Baker International, in an amount not to exceed $225,000 for interim planning services until the vacant City Planner position is filled.
Staff Report
11.
Consideration of Technology Advisory Committee Recommendations of December 12, 2018
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council review and approve the Technology Advisory Committee recommendations.
Staff Report
12.
Consideration of Traffic Safety Committee Recommendations of December 5, 2018
Recommendation: It is recommended that City Council review and approve the Traffic Safety Committee recommendation for installation of speed limit signs at 555/561 Paseo Lunado and 2209 Paseo Del Mar, with the exact locations for placement of the signs to be per the City Engineer.
Staff Report
13.
Planning Commission Actions of December 18, 2018
Recommendation: Receive and File.
a.
M-1295-18; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for a non-standard encroachment within the City right-of-way at the single family residence located at 956 Paseo La Cresta. Lot 1, Block 2223, Tract 6888. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant/
Owner: Chingmuh & Wei Shi Lee
Actions: Approved the application (4-0 in favor) with standard conditions.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to State law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.

(Resolution No. PCR- 2018-1096) (This Project is Exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.)

16.
Consideration of a Public Engagement Toolkit as a Policy Manual for Guiding the City’s Methods of Public Engagement
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the Palos Verdes Estates Public Engagement Toolkit, prepared by the Davenport Institute, establishing expectations, standards and guidance for public engagement on City matters or provide direction for next steps.
Staff Report
17.
Consider Proposed Settlement Ending Lawsuit Entitled Citizens for Enforcement of Parkland Covenants and John Harbison V. City of Palos Verdes Estates, Et Al. and Resolving Dispute over 2012 Agreement Among PVPUSD, PVHA, City & Luglianis. The Proposed Settlement would Affect the City’s Bluff Cove Properties (Located at 1009, 1015, 1017, 1101 , 1105, 1117, and 1121 Palos Verdes Drive West) and the Property Adjacent to 900 Via Panorama
